name: AARC Community Identity
description: Attributes to describe a user in the context of his community, as defined by AARC.

attributes.name: externalIds
attributes.description: External identifiers of the user (e.g. GitHub, Home Organisation identifier, gmail, etc).

subAttributes.name: iss
subAttributes.description: A URI that uniquely identifies the entity that issued the identifier.

subAttributes.name: claim_name
subAttributes.description: A case-sensitive string identifying the claim or attribute through which the issuer released the identifier.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: A non-empty string containing one identifier value exactly as released by the issuer.

subAttributes.name: pairwise
subAttributes.description: A Boolean indicating whether the identifier is pairwise. Defaults to false.

subAttributes.name: reassignable
subAttributes.description: A Boolean indicating whether the issuer may reassign the identifier value to another subject. Defaults to false.

subAttributes.name: globally_unique
subAttributes.description: Boolean indicating whether value is globally unique without considering iss or claim (when present). Defaults to false.

subAttributes.name: case_sensitive
subAttributes.description: A Boolean indicating whether case-sensitive comparison applies to value. Defaults to false.

attributes.name: organizationCountry
attributes.description: The country of the user’s Home Organisation. The attribute SHOULD use the two-letter ISO 3166 format or MUST use int for international organisations.

attributes.name: voPersonPolicyAgreement
attributes.description: The URL(s) describing policy(ies) (e.g. Acceptable Use Policy) that has been agreed to by the user.

subAttributes.name: nationalities
subAttributes.description: The countries of citizenship for the subject it is associated with. The attribute value(s) MUST use the two-letter ISO 3166 format.
